messages.subject: coord_cartesian question
parts:
Good afternoon,

I'm having trouble using the coord_cartesian function to impose limits on the scale of a plot similar to the following.


Here's the data.
tst <- data.frame( x = rep( c( "High", "High", "Low", "Low" ), 100 ), y = rnorm( 400, 10, 1000 ), z = rep( c( "a", "b", "b", "c"), 100) )


The following fails to limit the scale:

ggplot( tst, aes( x, y, colour = z) ) +
stat_summary( aes( group = interaction( x, z ) ),fun.y = "sum", geom = "point") +
facet_grid( z~. ) +
scale_y_continuous( formatter = "dollar") +
coord_cartesian( ylim = c( 0, 20000 ) ) +
coord_flip()

The following results in the coord_flip function to be over-ridden (but successfully limits the scale):

ggplot( tst,aes( x, y, colour = z) ) +
stat_summary( aes( group = interaction( x, z) ), fun.y = "sum", geom = "point" ) +
facet_grid( z~.) +
scale_y_continuous( formatter = "dollar" ) +
coord_flip() +
coord_cartesian( ylim = c( 0,20000 ) )

Any idea why the first plot doesn't do what I expect it to do? How can I alter it so that the scale, and not the data, will be limited to 20,000? Thanks for the help.


Adam Loveland

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: coord_cartesian question
parts:
Hi,

try this:

p <- ggplot( tst, aes( x, y, colour = z) ) +

stat_summary( aes( group = interaction( x, z ) ),fun.y = "sum", geom
= "point") +
facet_grid( z~. ) +
scale_y_continuous( formatter = "dollar")

# limits by scale
p + ylim(0, 20000) + coord_flip()

# limits by coord
p + coord_flip(ylim = c( 0, 20000 ))

#limits by coord with breaks adjustment
p + coord_flip(ylim = c( 0, 20000 ), wise = TRUE)
